title: 中式快餐四巨头③黄焖鸡米饭：一只砂锅，统治了写字楼午餐 | China's Fast-Food Giants P3 · Braised Chicken Rice 🍗
description:
灵魂拷问——你的黄焖鸡，加土豆还是加宽粉？ / The real question: potato or wide noodles in your braised chicken?

第③集·黄焖鸡米饭 —— 「中式快餐四巨头」系列，每天一个打工人午餐的国民品牌。
P3 · Braised Chicken Rice — from the series China's Fast-Food Giants: one everyday lunch legend a day.

一只砂锅，几乎统治了中国写字楼的午餐。黄焖鸡米饭来自山东济南——鸡腿肉配香菇、青椒，一口砂锅小火慢焖，浓汤浇在米饭上，能让人多干两碗。真正把它开遍全国的，是2011年济南人杨晓路创办的「杨铭宇黄焖鸡米饭」：第一家店开出后，近十年在中国乃至澳、新、日等地开出6000多家门店，各品牌加起来全国早已过万家。有意思的是，「杨铭宇」是创始人儿子的名字——寓意把店当亲儿子一样对待。济南人夸一样东西好，会说一句「杠赛来」。
One clay pot all but rules the office lunch across China. Braised chicken rice comes from Jinan, Shandong — chicken thigh with mushrooms and green peppers, slow-simmered in a clay pot, the rich sauce poured over rice to power you through two more bowls. The brand that spread it nationwide is Yang's Braised Chicken Rice, founded in 2011 by Jinan native Yang Xiaolu: from that first shop, it grew to over 6,000 outlets across China, Australia, New Zealand, Japan and more within about a decade — and across all brands the dish long ago passed 10,000 shops. A fun detail: "Yang Mingyu" is the founder's son's name — the idea being to treat the shop like your own child. When a Jinan local says something's great, they'll say "gàng-sài-lái."
